description: This source file implements a handler class for the Azure Foundry (Azure AI) Agent Service API, providing methods for synchronous, asynchronous, and streaming interactions with the service. It manages tasks such as creating threads, adding messages, creating and polling runs, and handling streaming SSE responses. The class encapsulates the logic required to communicate with Azure's AI services, constructing appropriate URLs, handling authentication via Bearer tokens, and processing responses to produce suitable model outputs.

classes.description: Handler class encapsulating methods to interact with Azure Foundry AI Agent Service, supporting sync, async, and streaming API calls.
